l2Selection: For each regularized family select one strength using seed78123 validation across both arms: maximize sum of selected first-choice matches, then minimize average selected pairwise loss; exact ties prefer smaller strength. No test metrics. Reuse the frozen pilot run for the final seed78123 result.
loss: Unchanged gallery-weighted pairwise logistic cross-entropy, sigmoid(8*score difference). Report data loss separately from added L2 penalty.
l2: 0.5*strength*sum of squared dense kernel weights, centered at zero. Exclude dense biases and BatchNorm gain/bias. Coupled L2 in Adam, not AdamW or the historical initial-weight anchor.

batchNorm.location: after each hidden dense layer and before ReLU; never on output score
batchNorm.runningVariance: EMA of unbiased per-batch variance, ddof1
batchNorm.rows: unique photo plus target meaning within each batch; repeated preferred comparisons never duplicate a photo's normalization weight
batchNorm.initialization: Train-only calibration. Gain=sqrt(running variance+epsilon), bias=training mean, initially matching the non-BN inference function. All gains/biases then train.
batchNorm.evaluation: Frozen running means/variances; never update from validation/test.

numerics: Vectorized NumPy research fitter; Float32 parameters/activations, double dot accumulation and Adam arithmetic. Baseline parity against production JS and sampled finite-difference gradients required. Not claimed bit-identical to JS or enabled for personal fitting.
checkpoint: Train every run for600epochs. Separately save final model and best validation first-choice checkpoint, pairwise loss tie-break, includes epoch0. Checkpoint selection never stops training.
smallBatch: For the four final families run the same kernel/recipe for600epochs on8distinct training families (training-only reused for selection). Require all gallery/pair orders correct and finite gradients; report actual loss including any irreducible regularization tradeoff.
testUse: Freeze pilot strengths and all24final fit/checkpoint states before test scoring. Post-hoc test curves every10epochs plus selected/final; no test-driven retuning. Preserve historical datasets and models byte-for-byte.
acceptance: Offline diagnostic only on the existing small retrospective set. No automatic app activation. BN can be algebraically folded into ordinary dense weights for independent JS inference checks.
limitations: 21heldoutmeaninggalleries, easy/curated and previously inspected; not a new blind test. Same21examples acrossseeds are not independent repetitions. Hyperparameter/grid/epoch conclusions limited to this setup.
